moments.title: UK Heatwave Peaks Today

angles.name: Stay Cool
angles.copy: It's officially the hottest day of the heatwave! Temperatures could hit 38°C in parts of England and Wales. Stay hydrated, stay safe, and find that shade! ☀️ #UKHeatwave

angles.name: Weather Alert
angles.copy: Amber warning for extreme heat across England and Wales today as the heatwave peaks. Fresher conditions are on the way, but for now, it's scorching! 🔥

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for an incredible 20th non-consecutive week, making it the longest-running UK number-one single of all time.

angles.name: Chart Reign
angles.copy: 20 weeks at number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean have made history with 'Rein Me In'. Is it the best chart-topper of all time? #UKCharts

angles.name: Longest Running
angles.copy: A monumental achievement! 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK number-one single ever. Huge congratulations to Sam Fender & Olivia Dean! 🎉
